fusions.name: Door Drops Behind
fusions.desc: Drops a ring of bars around you that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and holds each stunned for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrust Between Bars
fusions.desc: A thrust between the bars that deals 4 damage to a target up to 4 tiles away, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Shut In Together
fusions.desc: Shuts the door on everything near you: every creature within 3 tiles is held in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: No Gap to Slip
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 6% physical resistance.
